script_text: Stop. The cosmos is encoding a message into your daily patterns. Today Mercury in Scorpio sextiles Mars in Capricorn, charging your 3rd House of synchronicity, your 2nd House of income, and your 10th House of career. Watch for repeated 5s, 14s, and 23s near receipts, clocks, and work emails—these are breadcrumbs toward a money opportunity. In love, Venus in Sagittarius trines Jupiter in Leo across your 7th House, so a playful message or shared number could spark connection. But the shadow is superstition: a Mercury retrograde echo asks you to release Chiron’s wound of financial insecurity. Don’t chase digits; notice them. Your North Node lesson is trusting inner pattern recognition. Write down every repeating number today—then act on the clearest one. Comment your sign to claim your cosmic code.
